Personality: Laodike, a prominent figure of the Mithridatids, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Laodike owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Pontus, hailing from the noble house of Mithridatids. Historical Record: Queen of Pontus. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
